title: Insta360 GO Ultra Launches AI Voice Assistant: Regional Access to Qwen and Gemini, Thumb Camera Becomes Personal AI Entry Point

content_html:
Insta360, a Chinese tech company, has launched an AI voice assistant for its GO Ultra thumb camera, adopting different large model solutions based on regions: the Alibaba Qwen large model is integrated in the China mainland, while Google Gemini is used in the Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas markets. This feature is core to Insta360's self-developed technology, combining Qwen's multimodal capabilities and photo-based question-answering functions. On-device, it performs voiceprint recognition and intent identification, while the cloud handles complex tasks such as answering questions, switching modes, and translation. The translated results can be directly broadcast through the device's speaker. Insta360 founder Liu Jingkang stated that this will "redefine the thumb camera," and he mentioned that it might become the largest personal AI assistant in terms of inventory and sales volume, apart from Meta.

The AI voice assistant integrates three core capabilities: face-to-face translation, image-based question-answering, and voice-based question-answering. Users can activate it by saying "Hey Kira" or by long-pressing the shutter button when the device is off. Face-to-face translation supports bidirectional real-time translation, covering scenarios such as asking for directions, ordering food, and shopping; image-based question-answering captures the lens view after authorization, identifying elements like road signs, buildings, and dishes, and providing voice feedback; voice-based question-answering does not use the camera, directly responding to general information queries such as weather and routes. The combination of these three features upgrades the thumb camera from a simple photography tool into an intelligent terminal that can perceive and converse.

A New Player Enters the Wearable AI Arena

GO Ultra was released last August at a price of 2598 yuan. It features a lightweight 53-gram cube-shaped body, equipped with a 1/1.28-inch large sensor and a 5nm AI chip, supporting 4K60fps high-frame video recording. By introducing an AI voice assistant into this form factor, Insta360 has essentially opened up a new path in the wearable AI hardware market, distinct from smart glasses and smart speakers. The lightweight wearing advantage of the thumb camera naturally makes it suitable as a full-time AI assistant carrier, while the built-in camera provides a hardware foundation for multimodal interaction.

Selecting different large models based on regions reflects the practical considerations faced by domestic hardware manufacturers in their global expansion. Using Alibaba Qwen in the China mainland ensures compliance and data localization, while using Gemini in overseas markets provides broader general capabilities. This strategy may also serve as a reference model for other hardware companies expanding abroad. As Meta's smart glasses, OpenAI's ice ball devices, and Rabbit's handheld devices enter the market, the competitive landscape for personal AI assistant hardware is accelerating. Whether Insta360 can secure a place in this arena depends on continuous optimization of the AI experience and deep development of the ecosystem.

content_html_zh:
中国科技公司Insta360为其GO Ultra拇指相机推出了AI语音助手，根据地区采用不同的大型号解决方案：中国大陆采用阿里巴巴Qwen大型号，而港澳台及海外市场则采用Google Gemini。 该功能是Insta360自主研发技术的核心，结合了Qwen的多模态能力和基于照片的问答功能。 它在设备上执行声纹识别和意图识别，而云端则处理回答问题、切换模式和翻译等复杂任务。 翻译结果可以通过设备的扬声器直接播放。 Insta360创始人刘靖康表示，这将“重新定义拇指相机”，并提到它可能成为除Meta之外库存和销量最大的个人AI助手。

AI语音助手集成了面对面翻译、图像问答、语音问答三大核心能力。 用户可以通过说“Hey Kira”或在设备关闭时长按快门按钮来激活它。 面对面翻译支持双向实时翻译，覆盖问路、点餐、购物等场景；基于图像的问答在授权后捕获镜头视图，识别路标、建筑物、菜肴等元素，并提供语音反馈；语音问答不使用摄像头，直接回答天气、路线等一般信息查询。 这三个功能的结合，让拇指相机从一个简单的摄影工具升级为一个可以感知、可以对话的智能终端。

新玩家进入可穿戴人工智能领域

GO Ultra于去年8月发布，售价2598元。 它采用轻质53克的立方体机身，配备1/1.28英寸大传感器和5nm AI芯片，支持4K60fps高帧视频录制。 通过在这种外形中引入人工智能语音助手，Insta360本质上在可穿戴人工智能硬件市场开辟了一条不同于智能眼镜和智能音箱的新路径。 拇指摄像头的轻量化佩戴优势自然使其适合作为专职AI助理载体，而内置摄像头则为多模态交互提供了硬件基础。

根据地区选择不同的大型机型，体现了国内硬件厂商全球化扩张所面临的现实考虑。 在中国大陆使用阿里巴巴Qwen可以确保合规性和数据本地化，而在海外市场使用Gemini则可以提供更广泛的通用能力。 这一策略也可为其他硬件企业海外扩张提供参考。 随着Meta的智能眼镜、OpenAI的冰球设备、Rabbit的手持设备进入市场，个人AI助理硬件的竞争格局正在加速。 Insta360能否在这一领域占据一席之地，取决于AI体验的持续优化和生态的深度发展。
